font.reason: A neutral variable-weight Persian UI sans suits the restrained academic paper feed, supports the range of UI weights, and shapes Persian and Persian digits reliably.

rtlDecisions.what: Paper-feed header, navigation, article titles, metadata, summaries, project labels and descriptions
rtlDecisions.action: Rebuilt as Persian DOM text, right-aligned and set direction:rtl; replaced the source screenshot surface with a matching paper-feed layout.
rtlDecisions.why: These are localized UI strings and follow Persian reading order. Raster screenshots baked in Chinese and English text that could not be translated in place.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated to «رادار مقاله» and «از ۳۱ مقالهٔ امروز»; moved the counter from top-right to top-left; changed the odometer strip to Persian digits ۰–۹.
rtlDecisions.why: The counter is a feed-side UI element, so its placement follows the mirrored reading/layout order. Numeric progression and digit order remain unchanged.

rtlDecisions.what: Card entry positions, alternating tilt, stack compression and camera follow
rtlDecisions.action: Kept positions, cues, easing, scale, tilt signs, stack press values, camera keyframes and frame timings unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: Vertical entrance, gravity and camera tracking are physical motion; the centered stack has no meaningful horizontal reading sequence to mirror.

rtlDecisions.action: Anchored the highlight to the card's inline end (right) and moved its accent edge to the left; retained width and grow/fade timing.
rtlDecisions.why: The highlight is attached to the RTL project label; its origin and trailing edge follow the text direction.

rtlDecisions.action: Reversed the horizontal sweep anchor and gradient angle; negated the decorative 14° tilt.
rtlDecisions.why: This single finishing sweep carries directional reading flow and should travel right-to-left.

rtlDecisions.action: Used Persian digits for visible counts and removed uppercase/tracking treatment from the counter labels.
rtlDecisions.why: Persian UI uses Persian digits; letter-spacing and uppercase styling are unsuitable for Persian shaping.

rasterHandling.action: The full source screenshot plate is covered by a newly typeset Persian page surface. The flying screenshot cards were replaced with Persian DOM-built card surfaces and translated article-style titles, metadata, summaries, project tags and descriptions. No source raster text is visible in the localized render.
rasterHandling.note: Card copy is a concise Persian reconstruction of the visible research-feed subjects and layout, not a line-by-line transcription of every baked screenshot string.

motionFidelity.timingNote: Persian card copy is static within each card, so the original per-card landing and counter beats remain unchanged.

verification.visualNotes: Compared localized/original frames at the entrance, card arrivals and final stack. Persian page text and cards render without visible source screenshot text; all five card surfaces are present by the final frame and the counter settles at ۵.

concerns: The source screenshot contains dense baked research copy. The localized card copy preserves the research-feed subject and visual hierarchy but is a concise reconstruction rather than a verbatim translation of every raster line.
